hard_gates.blocking_state: the task enters Needs Input before a final Brief is produced
hard_gates.visible_conflict: the action request shows both conflicting values, their source identities and versions, usable locators, and the affected product-identity scope
hard_gates.recovery_scope: after a confirm or replacement, processing resumes from the fact stage or the stage named by the current action request
hard_gates.current_truth: unresolved or superseded outputs never become Current Truth or an export source
hard_gates.no_model_arbitration: the model or deterministic substitute must not silently choose a conflict value

evidence_constraints: Both values are synthetic test assertions; neither is a real catalog or warehouse record.
The request is derived only from the existing Task, Source, Conflict, and Stage context.
No free-form chat, outside fact, or fabricated source may resolve the conflict.
human_usability_inputs: The operator can see why the identity conflict blocks the next stage.
The operator can select a finite action and understand what will resume afterward.
non_requirements: Do not require a fixed prose template beyond these semantic fields.
Do not mark the task successful merely because a Needs Input card was rendered; generation success is not approval.
